description: Land Acquisition - Nigollayaya, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of specific land parcels for a public purpose. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, providing detailed descriptions of the properties to be acquired, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. It falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition, which is a core land and property-related matter.
